findings.source: libs/VM.sol:117-136 runLoop: for (pc = ctx.vm.nextPC; pc < programBytes.length; ) { ... ctx.vm.opcodes[opcode](ctx, args); ... }
findings.issue: swap runs the VM through a specialised copy of runLoop (internal_0x12ec, return address 4990 passed as a parameter) whose body aborts right after the RunLoopExcessiveCall check, so the text of swap has no interpreter loop and no instruction effects at all; only quote's copy (internal_0x1356) shows the loop and the opcode dispatch.
findings.rule: Coverage limit (an internal function whose return jump targets a stack parameter the decompiler does not match); handle a jump to the return-address parameter as the function's return.

findings.source: libs/Power.sol:16-22 while (exponent > 0) { if (exponent & 1 == 1) result = result * base / precision; base = base * base / precision; exponent >>= 1; }
findings.issue: The exponent is carried by two loop variables (t tests, v computes) that always hold the same value, and the one-armed `if` is printed as two arms with an SSA copy.
findings.rule: Merge loop variables with equal initial values and equal updates; print `if c: w = f(w)` instead of `if c: _x = f(w) else: _x = w; w = _x`.
